project.title: Transactional sequence allocation
project.goal: Provide exact shared sequence allocation for the Rust posting pipeline.
project.scope: R12 storage primitive on synthetic owned connections; full goal unchanged.

excludes: Original writer admission and product mutation endpoints

action.allocate_sequence.description: Exact transaction-owned sequence allocation and conditional reservation

errors.invalid_input: Refuse as specified in CONTRACT.md; caller aborts owner transaction.
errors.invalid_ledger: Refuse as specified in CONTRACT.md; caller aborts owner transaction.
errors.sequence_exhausted: Refuse as specified in CONTRACT.md; caller aborts owner transaction.
errors.storage_failure: Refuse as specified in CONTRACT.md; caller aborts owner transaction.
errors.transaction_required: Refuse as specified in CONTRACT.md; caller aborts owner transaction.

preconditions: Existing admitted company connection; main write transaction for allocation; caller retains authority/lease and aborts on errors.
postconditions: Only exact requested sequence advances; no internal owner commit.
external_effects: SQLite changes inside caller transaction only; no filesystem opens or original data paths.

authorization.rationale: Primitive grants no authority; caller admission remains required.

idempotency.rationale: Sequence allocation itself is not an idempotency receipt.

boundaries.rationale: Typed integer limits and write-state admission.

atomicity.rationale: No internal commit; owner rollback/crash restores all effects.

action.allocate_sequence.behavior: Read current under existing connection; require main Write state, exact checked arithmetic, conditional reserve; outer transaction owns atomicity.

scenario.normal.description: Same safe integer results and exact stored rows; independent scopes and company fallback.

scenario.given: Existing admitted synthetic company schema and immediate transaction.
scenario.when: Run current/next/reserve vectors and compare actual TS oracle.
scenario.then: Same safe integer results and exact stored rows; independent scopes and company fallback.

scenario.mismatch.description: Return ok false with current/expected and unchanged rows.

scenario.then: Return ok false with current/expected and unchanged rows.

scenario.invalid.description: Typed precondition/limit refusal before sequence writes; every error requires owner abort, including post-write storage failures.

scenario.given: Negative input, invalid stored SQLite type, exhaustion or transaction without write lock.
scenario.then: Typed precondition/limit refusal before sequence writes; every error requires owner abort, including post-write storage failures.

scenario.failure.description: Both sequence and companion changes disappear; immutable guards remain active.

scenario.given: An allocation plus companion row precedes SQL/business failure.
scenario.then: Both sequence and companion changes disappear; immutable guards remain active.

scenario.concurrent.description: Unique committed automatic values; exactly one manual winner; no snapshot upgrade race.

scenario.given: Separate processes/connections share synthetic SQLite file.
scenario.when: Race auto allocations and identical manual reservation under immediate transactions.
scenario.then: Unique committed automatic values; exactly one manual winner; no snapshot upgrade race.

scenario.crash.description: Only prior committed state remains and next number is reusable.

scenario.given: Child allocated and inserted companion row before commit.
scenario.when: Kill and reap child; reopen and retry.
scenario.then: Only prior committed state remains and next number is reusable.
